author: Baba, 1959

note.en: A small green sea hare that hides in algae and seagrass, known here from five museum specimens at Manzanillo and Punta Mona.
note.es: Una pequeña liebre de mar verde que se esconde en algas y pasto marino, conocida aquí por cinco ejemplares de museo de Manzanillo y Punta Mona.

evidence: GBIF: 5 museum specimens, 6 to 16 m, 1999 to 2001

sources.t: GBIF: preserved specimens, Universidad de Costa Rica collection (Calderón, Avila and others, 1998 to 2003)
WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and classification

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 5 museum specimens, 6 to 16 m, 1999 to 2001.

marks.en: Soft, shell-less sea hare, mottled green-brown, living on seagrass.
marks.es: Liebre de mar blanda y sin concha, moteada verde pardo, que vive sobre pastos marinos.
